definitions.explanation: Physical bending or winding of a road, river, or path.
Figuratively, the various difficulties, changes, and complications encountered along the way. Very commonly used in the expression 紆余曲折.

examples.japanese: ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{曲折|きょくせつ}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{山間部|さんかんぶ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{曲折|きょくせつ}し⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{流|なが}れている→流れる：01969_nagareru⟧。
examples.english: The river flows through the mountainous area, winding as it goes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧な{曲折|きょくせつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦{山道|やまみち}→山道：12406_yamamichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{運転|うんてん}→運転：01335_unten⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: Mountain roads with sharp bends in succession are difficult to drive.

examples.japanese: ⟦{紆余|うよ}→紆余：20891_uyo⟧{曲折|きょくせつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{経|へ}て→経る：13876_heru⟧⟦{完成|かんせい}した→完成する：25528_kanseisuru⟧。
examples.english: It was completed after many twists and turns.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{紆余|うよ}→紆余：20891_uyo⟧{曲折|きょくせつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{最終的|さいしゅうてき}→最終的：13013_saishuuteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}した→成功する：21445_seikousuru⟧。
examples.english: This plan had many complications, but it ultimately succeeded.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{紆余|うよ}→紆余：20891_uyo⟧{曲折|きょくせつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{乗|の}り{越|こ}えて→乗り越える：04620_norikoeru⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I am who I am today because I overcame life's many ups and downs.

notes:
USAGE:
The figurative sense (sense 2) is far more common than the literal sense. {曲折|きょくせつ} almost always appears in the four-character compound ⟦{紆余|うよ}→紆余：20891_uyo⟧{曲折|きょくせつ}, which is one of the most frequently used yojijukugo.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{紆余|うよ}→紆余：20891_uyo⟧{曲折|きょくせつ} (twists and turns, complications)
- ⟦{紆余|うよ}→紆余：20891_uyo⟧{曲折|きょくせつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{経|へ}て→経る：13876_heru⟧ (after many twists and turns)
- ⟦{紆余|うよ}→紆余：20891_uyo⟧{曲折|きょくせつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧ (there were complications)
- {曲折|きょくせつ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧ (a winding road)
